title.en: An Act Establishing a Regular District Office of the Land Transportation Office in the Municipality of Orani, Province of Bataan and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.orig: An Act Establishing a Regular District Office of the Land Transportation Office in the Municipality of Orani, Province of Bataan and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.vi: Đạo luật thành lập một Văn phòng Khu vực Chính quy Land Transportation Office tại Đô thị Orani, Tỉnh Bataan, và phân bổ kinh phí cho mục đích này
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติจัดตั้งสำนักงานเขตปกติ Land Transportation Office ในเทศบาล Orani จังหวัด Bataan และจัดสรรเงินทุนสำหรับการนี้
title.id: Undang-Undang membentuk sebuah Kantor Distrik Reguler Land Transportation Office di Kotamadya Orani, Provinsi Bataan, dan mengalokasikan dana untuk itu
title.ms: Akta menubuhkan sebuah Pejabat Daerah Biasa Land Transportation Office di Perbandaran Orani, Wilayah Bataan, dan memperuntukkan dana untuk itu

text.en: Theres shall be established, under the Department of Transportation and Communications, a regular district office of the Land Transportation Office (LTO) in the Municipality of Orani, Province of Bataan.

The Secretary of Transportation and Communications shall immediately include in the Department's programs the operationalization of the LTO Regular District's Office in the Municipality of Orani, Province of Bataan, the funding of which shall be included in the annual General Appropriation Act.
This Act shall take effect fifteen (15) days after its publication in two (2) newspapers of general circulation.
